name: @8bitscript/examples
description: The example programs that ship with the toolchain: small, complete 8BitScript projects the editor's launcher lists beside your own, starting with the two hello-world programs the 0.2.0 native backend is built to run.

hello-raw.title: Hello, raw
hello-raw.description: Eleven stores straight into the PET's screen RAM. The first program the native backend builds: no text package, no strings, no function but main.

hello.title: Hello, PET
hello.description: HELLO WORLD through the portable text package. The same four lines build for the PET and the web; this is the 0.2.0 goal program.
